reviewedScope: Complete new preserve_prior_df026 definition, its before-Cargo and final-after-cleanup call sites, actual global signal handler and original OUTER_UNTIL
All changed runner diff hunks and complete raw source hash, not independent new Rust/build/runtime qualification

findings.name: registered_open_custody
findings.detail: Row exists before open. protected increments before os.open and remains positive through row.opened, reads, named/held identity checks and the nested finally close. It decrements only after the close attempt and ledger update, so a SIGINT/SIGTERM received after open is deferred, then observed through pending_signal without skipping closure.

findings.name: bounded_read_and_cancellation
findings.detail: Pending cancellation and bounded_remaining(OUTER_UNTIL) are checked before every at-most-1MiB os.read. Declared size is checked before reading, count never admits more than size, SHA covers the complete file, and a further deadline/cancellation check occurs after complete full9/name verification. The shared outer deadline is not reset.

findings.name: completion_and_final_close
findings.detail: The per-file finally marks close_attempted before one os.close and sets closed only after return. BaseException preserves close_error_type and propagates. The outer finally calculates all_opened_descriptors_closed over every registered row; no unopened row is claimed opened, and an unconfirmed opened row is false. No blind repeated close exists.

findings.name: post_close_deadline
findings.detail: After all file closures, bounded_remaining and pending_signal are checked before setting status=unchanged. Late final close cannot produce successful helper status. Synchronous metadata/read/close calls are late-rejected, not individually preempted.

findings.name: retained_files_separate_from_cache
findings.detail: The six constant receipt/artifact/libtest paths require resolve(strict=True)==literal, not-relative-to the fixed args.target, regular owner file, expected exact size/mode, nlink1, before/after named+FD full9 equality and whole SHA. The helper only opens readonly and contains no write/mkdir/copy/rename/unlink. Future correctness continues to require the separately reviewed fixed launcher target/output bindings.

findings.name: before_and_after_cargo
findings.detail: The before record must be unchanged and all opened descriptors closed before rustc/Cargo. The after record is allocated after the existing owned-child cleanup and must equal the entire before record. Any failure, cancellation, closure error or expired original outer deadline preserves failed terminal status; no new target reconstruction branch is introduced by this helper.

limitations: Sequential full9/hash/name fences do not provide a global filesystem transaction or exclusion of all possible concurrent ABA races.
